images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 28 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light ivory plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 72 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: a black wool single-breasted long overcoat folded neatly, a light heather grey fine-gauge wool crewneck knit sweater, charcoal grey straight-leg wool trousers with center crease, a small black leather crossbody bag, black leather derby shoes. RIGHT HALF: a full-body street style photo of a young Korean man in his 20s wearing exactly the same items: the black knee-length wool overcoat worn open over the light heather grey crewneck knit, charcoal straight trousers, black derby shoes, small black crossbody bag across the body, walking forward pulling a silver aluminium suitcase in a bright modern airport terminal hall, headless body-only framing cut at the collarbone, NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible, only in the lower 72 percent. Identical items in both halves, realistic fabric textures, soft cool morning daylight, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no signs.
